summary: Holds the JWT in a module-level variable (api/client.ts), never localStorage — a hard refresh always logs the user out by design.
reasoning: This was the auth task's own stated security assumption, not my call to relax. If a persisted session is ever wanted, it needs a refresh-token endpoint and a decision on where that refresh token lives (httpOnly cookie is the standard answer) — not just switching this back to localStorage, which would defeat the reason it was avoided. Registered with setUnauthorizedHandler in api/client.ts so an expired token mid-session forces logout rather than every request failing silently.
